caption.en: DUFOMap, BeautyMap and GT on the same selected teaser entries; fixed view, raw / removed / retained. Offline final maps, not online updates.
caption.zh: 同一批 teaser 条目的 DUFOMap、BeautyMap、真值：固定视角，原始／移除／保留。使用最终离线地图，不表现为在线更新。

caption.en: One named frame, same world bounds and point identities across every method and GT.
caption.zh: 明确帧号，同一世界坐标范围、同一点身份，对照各方法和真值。

caption.en: Measured versus paper values, with AA and HA separated and evaluator differences annotated.
caption.zh: 实测与论文差值，AA／HA 分开，注明评价器差异。

caption.en: Same-instance DUFOMap: direct identities, nearest neighbors of the same kept points and native export; 141 frames, zero injected error.
caption.zh: 同实例 DUFOMap：直接身份、相同保留点的最近邻、原生输出；141 帧，零注入误差。

caption.en: Pose, correspondence, evidence and provisional updates; empirical observations separated from conjectured feedback.
caption.zh: 位姿、对应、证据与暂定更新；实测观察与猜测反馈分开。

caption.en: Real teaser, six direct-label sensitivity cells; no paper-table or semantic-navigation comparison.
caption.zh: 真实 teaser 的六组直接标签敏感性；不作论文表格或语义导航比较。

caption.en: Exact, independent-noise and correlated-drift conditions at matched marginal error; fixed frontend and view.
caption.zh: 相同边际误差下精确／独立噪声／相关漂移；固定前端与视角。

caption.en: First an author semantic-map baseline, then delayed correction and object queries with validity/coverage shown.
caption.zh: 先作者语义地图基线，再迟到修正和对象查询；显示有效性与覆盖率。

caption.en: Oracle identity/visibility, minority versus majority movers; include the median failure.
caption.zh: 已知身份／可见性，少数与多数运动；保留中位数失败。

caption.en: Gaussian shared bias with known scales; false deletion, Brier and changed-object recall together.
caption.zh: 已知尺度的高斯共享偏差；同时报告误删、Brier 与变化召回。

caption.en: Held-out risk–coverage and risk–latency curves; validation-only tuning and uncertainty intervals.
caption.zh: 留出风险—覆盖率／延迟曲线；参数只由验证集选取，带不确定性区间。

caption.en: Unchanged, moved, removed, occluded and no-stable-anchor cases; no curated success-only sequence.
caption.zh: 不变、移动、移除、遮挡、缺锚点情形；不只挑成功序列。
